name: Field Doctor - Beef Ragu Penne
ingredients:
400g Extra lean organic beef (26%) 
892ml Tomatoes (58%)
153ml Extra virgin olive oil (10%)
138ml Tomato puree (9%)
77g Spinach (5%)
31g Pitted kalamata olives (2%)
31g Mixed herbs (2%)
15g Sun dried tomatoes (1%) (Sulphites),
15g Parmesan cheese (1%) (Milk) 
1 Red peppers 
1 Carrots 
1tsp Soy sauce
1sp Wine vinegar (Sulphites)
pinch Salt
tsp Paprika
pinch Black pepper
15g Chives
350g Gluten free organic brown rice penne (21%) 
  + Brown rice flour
directions:
Fry the carrots and red pepper, then brown the beef in olive oil.

Add the other ingredients and simmer.
notes:
